You are a careful, neutral coder of the REALIZED OUTCOME of a corporate transaction
over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

# Outcome sub-dossier — realized record ~3-4 years after separation (FY2011)

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. This sub-dossier describes ONLY the realized

> information about how the transaction was structured at closing.

## Outcome window
- Fixed outcome window: fiscal year ended December 31, 2011, as reported in the annual report on Form 10-K filed February 22, 2012 (approximately three-plus years after the beverage business became an independent public company). Selected multi-year figures cited below are as tabulated in that same filing. [SRC: SEC accession 0001418135-12-000006, Form 10-K FY ended 2011-12-31]

## Realized financial trajectory
- Net sales were $5,903 million for 2011, compared with $5,636 million for 2010 and $5,531 million for 2009. [SRC: SEC accession 0001418135-12-000006, Form 10-K FY2011 selected financial data]
- Net sales increased $267 million, or approximately 5%, for the year ended December 31, 2011 compared with the prior year. [SRC: SEC accession 0001418135-12-000006, Form 10-K FY2011]
- Net income (loss) as tabulated in the five-year selected financial data was: $606 million (2011), $528 million (2010), $555 million (2009), $(312) million (2008) and $497 million (2007). [SRC: SEC accession 0001418135-12-000006, Form 10-K FY2011 selected financial data]
- Best-documented outcome scalar: net income of $606 million for the year ended December 31, 2011, compared with $528 million for the year ended December 31, 2010. [SRC: SEC accession 0001418135-12-000006, Form 10-K FY2011]

## Goodwill / intangible-asset record
- Based on the annual impairment analysis performed as of December 31, 2011, "no impairment was required for our indefinite lived intangible assets and goodwill." [SRC: SEC accession 0001418135-12-000006, Form 10-K FY2011]

## Realized operating configuration (product / process / organization)
- The company reported its business in three operating segments: Beverage Concentrates, Packaged Beverages and Latin America Beverages. [SRC: SEC accession 0001418135-12-000006, Form 10-K FY2011]
- The company continued to describe itself as "a leading integrated brand owner, manufacturer and distributor of non-alcoholic beverages" and stated its integrated business model "provides opportunities for net sales and profit growth through the alignment of the economic interests of our brand ownership and our manufacturing and distribution" operations. [SRC: SEC accession 0001418135-12-000006, Form 10-K FY2011]
- As of December 31, 2011 the company employed approximately 19,000 employees, including approximately 5,000 full-time manufacturing employees in its facilities. [SRC: SEC accession 0001418135-12-000006, Form 10-K FY2011]
- The Beverage Concentrates segment reported net sales of $1,193 million for 2011 (versus $1,156 million for 2010) and the Packaged Beverages segment reported net sales of $4,292 million for 2011 (versus $4,098 million for 2010). [SRC: SEC accession 0001418135-12-000006, Form 10-K FY2011 segment results]

## Capital return
- The company declared its first dividend of $0.15 per share on outstanding common stock, paid on January 8, 2010, and described a capital-deployment approach of paying dividends, repurchasing shares and reducing debt. [SRC: SEC accession 0001418135-12-000006, Form 10-K FY2011]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Over the realized 3-4-year window the standalone company recorded rising net sales ($5,531M → $5,636M → $5,903M across 2009-2011) and net income of $555M / $528M / $606M across 2009-2011, with no goodwill or indefinite-lived intangible impairment required as of December 31, 2011; it operated through three reportable segments and retained the integrated brand-ownership-plus-manufacturing-and-distribution model. [SRC: SEC accession 0001418135-12-000006, Form 10-K FY2011]
- No documented fracture at the product/process or process/organization interface is recorded in the FY2011 annual report within this outcome window; the realized record over the window is one of sustained profitability. [SRC: SEC accession 0001418135-12-000006, Form 10-K FY2011]

[SLICE END]
